architecture: v4 (re-root 2026-11-02 after architecture 3's heart BLOCK: Ardmuir University Library's 2027 Course Texts Fund split across faculties by the hold-weeks beyond two that students faced on one-user e-textbook licences, a cancelled hold's wait read from the queue's own order)
niche: a university library's one-user course e-textbook licences: each faculty's share of a new 2027 Course Texts Fund set by the weeks beyond the second that its students' spring 2026 holds waited, or would have waited had the student kept the hold, for a copy, when students give up on long queues and buy the book
analyst_test: A strong analyst who reads the fund's terms and every file correctly sums each faculty's hold-weeks beyond the second from the holds that were offered a copy, or completes the cancelled holds with a Kaplan-Meier curve that treats each cancellation as censoring, and files a split that short-changes the faculties whose students abandon long queues, against the golden's split.
domain_test: The deciding quantity is each faculty's expected wait beyond two weeks over every hold its students placed, a waiting-time distribution censored by cancellations that are themselves driven by the wait, the general-statistics censored-data estimate; replace it with the waits of the holds that were served or with a censoring-blind survival curve and the split changes, so the method, not a backdrop, decides.
layer1: the lending platform stamps holds and loans in UTC while the library management system and the reading-list tool keep UK local time, the clocks changing inside the semester
titles keyed by the platform's own ID in the holds and loans exports, by ISBN in the licence register and by the catalogue's record number in the reading lists
the 1 August 2026 restructure that merged two faculties, so spring holds carry the old faculty codes and the fund is split across the new ones
the student feed is a snapshot taken after graduation, so students who left in June appear only in the historical enrolment extract
two holds exports with overlapping dates (the March download and the October download)
a hold whose copy was offered but not collected inside the platform's collection window shows as expired, not fulfilled
licence orders carrying several copies on one line, renewals as new lines, and metered licences that lapse after a set number of loans
stakeholder_role: head of collections and content, a university library

spine.entity: one hold placed on a one-user course e-textbook

world.geography: United Kingdom (Scotland; the university, its city, its faculties and its lending platform are fictional)

driver: The decisive quantity is how long every member who joined a first-come-first-served queue waited, or would have waited, to be served, when members leave the queue more often the further back they stand; the served members' waits and a survival curve that treats each departure as uninformative both understate it, and only the service time of the first member behind each leaver who was served, read from the queue's own order, gives the wait the leaver faced, which summed past a threshold over each group splits a fixed total.
driver_concrete: Each faculty's share of the 2027 Course Texts Fund is its students' share of the weeks beyond the second that their spring 2026 holds on one-user e-textbook licences waited, or would have waited had the student kept the hold, for a copy; a cancelled hold's wait is the time the platform offered a copy to the first hold placed after it on the same title that was offered one, because copies go to holds in the order placed and students cancel more the further down the queue they stand, so neither the fulfilled holds alone nor a Kaplan-Meier curve with cancellations censored gives it.
stump: A competent analyst sums each faculty's hold-weeks beyond the second from the holds the platform fulfilled, or completes the cancelled holds with a Kaplan-Meier curve that treats a cancellation as uninformative censoring, and files a split that gives too little to the faculties whose students cancel long holds and buy the book; only each cancelled hold's turn, read from the first later hold on the same title that was offered a copy, gives the waits the fund is split on.

differentiation.task148: task148 v2 forecasts a 911 late shift's answer rate under Erlang A, estimating the patience that drains the queue from waits the answer censors; task281 measures no patience and forecasts no staffing: it reads the wait each cancelled hold would have faced from the service time of the first later hold on the same title, a reconstruction from the queue's own order of the waits that informative cancellations hide.

lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is a classifier's hit rate on the positive class at each of several sites and each of a few decision thresholds, known only from a validation batch read against a reference standard; the batch's items were captured on two kinds of device whose hit rates differ widely at every threshold, in a mix that leaves every site's and every recorded subgroup's rate near the pooled one, and the device behind each item is in no column, recovered only by placing each item's site and date in a dated register of where each device stood, so each site's threshold is set on hit rates carried device by device at the share of its own items each device captured, not pooled, not site by site and not by any recorded subgroup.
lineage.driver_concrete: Each clinic's 2027 operating point is the least sensitive of the vendor's points at which the AI's sensitivity for referable diabetic retinopathy among the clinic's reference-year screenings reaches 85 per cent, that sensitivity being the local validation study's sensitivity on each retinal camera model at the point (the model behind each validation image recovered by placing its clinic and capture date in the biomedical engineering register's placements) weighted by the share of the clinic's screenings each model captured; pooled, pilot by pilot or reweighted to any recorded subgroup, the standard point clears 85 per cent everywhere.
lineage.stump: A competent analyst carries the local validation study's sensitivity at each operating point to every clinic, pooled, pilot by pilot or reweighted to each clinic's patient mix, and sets all twelve clinics at the vendor's standard point; the study's images came from two camera models whose sensitivities differ by about thirty points at that point in a mix that hides it, and only each model's sensitivity, the model behind each image recovered from the camera register's placement dates and carried by each clinic's own camera mix, moves five clinics to more sensitive points.
lineage.world: a community health center network's diabetic retinopathy screening AI (Corrowan Valley Community Health, Oregon)
lineage.fate: judge APPROVE and leak reader clean, blocked at guard.py heart (strategy composition_mix, artifact filed_standard, role compliance_or_audit, shape 07, forum executive_team) with no author waiver; re-rooted 2026-11-02

lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is the share of each group's surviving units that will suffer one wear-out failure before a fixed age, read past a record whose follow-up ends early in the wear-out, when part of the units carry a part from a source that never wears out that way; the record is too young to show the plateau, so one lifetime fit on every unit passes its back-test and treats those units' zeros as failures still to come, and only a provenance record kept for warranty claims, joined unit by unit through the delivery lot, shows which units are at risk at all.
lineage.driver_concrete: Each conversion phase's share of luminaires still on their original driver on 1 January 2027 whose driver will fail before the luminaire's twelfth year comes from a Weibull fitted only to the drivers of the maker whose drivers wear out; the other maker's drivers, identified only through the installer's lot numbers and the manufacturer's certificates of conformance, show no wear-out, so one fit over every luminaire reads their zeros as failures still to come and puts every phase in the program.
lineage.stump: A competent solver fits the lifecycle model's Weibull with suspensions to every conversion driver and projects each phase's original-driver luminaires, filing all ten phases into the 2027 group driver replacement program at 68 to 71 per cent each; Corvane's drivers, found only through the installer's lot numbers and the luminaire maker's certificates of conformance, show no wear-out (16 failures against the 555 that fit expects), so the fit belongs to Vantrel's drivers alone and only P1, P3, P5, P7 and P9 clear 45 per cent.
lineage.world: an investor-owned electric utility's company-owned LED streetlights (Tallisford Power & Light, Ohio)
lineage.fate: re-rooted 2026-11-01 at the Batch 3 queue reset, after a portal determinism return and then a landed call on the shipped version; one architecture per world closes the streetlight world

lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is each group's need in a coming year read from an upper cut of its weekly shortfall distribution, rebuilt from last year's shortfalls with that year's own structural gaps replaced by the coming year's planned ones, and the added capacity rated at the availability of the newest members who will fill it; last year's weeks as they stood, or the group's average availability, each file other counts.
lineage.driver_concrete: Each unit's FY2028 relief positions are its fifth-heaviest week of backfill need over the weekly hours a relief officer works, the need built from FY2026's absences plus the vacant lines the FY2028 position control carries until each academy class graduates, the hours from the July 2025 academy class's first year; not FY2026's weeks with their own vacant lines, and not the unit's average availability.
lineage.stump: A competent solver executes the standard and rates a relief position at the title's average officer (32.4 to 35.3 hours on post a week), filing 63 positions, three short; the positions are filled from the July 2027 entry classes, and the July 2025 classes' first year (7.8 per cent off post against 14.5) puts a holder at 36.7 to 37.0 hours, so 59 are placed and one returns to the reserve.
lineage.fate: spent 2026-10-27 at the portal: both top responses landed the call (59 of 60, one returned) by rating the relief positions at the July 2025 entry classes' first-year off-post share, the Director's memo having named the July 2027 entry classes; the world screened for a new step the same day and set aside, the axes then banned (government_agency, budget_or_appropriation, research_desk, filed_standard)

notes: Architecture 4, re-rooted 2026-11-02 after architecture 3 (judge APPROVE, leak reader clean) was blocked at guard.py heart on window bans with no author waiver. New world (a Scottish research university library's course e-textbook lending), new task type (missing-data-censoring-measurement-error), objective kept (Descriptive & Distribution Analysis). Strategy informative_censoring: a hold's wait is observed only until the student cancels, and students cancel more the further back in the queue they stand, so the cancellation window carries information about the wait inside it; no live card near the end of the draw order holds the strategy (latest task191, 2026-10-31). Forcing event incident_or_complaint: the University Court upheld the Students' Association's complaint about e-textbook waits and created the fund, its split due with the complaint's resolution.
